record.paper_title: Noncommutative spectral geometry of Riemannian foliations: some results and open problems
record.original_question: Let (M, F) be a compact foliated manifold of codimension q and E a vector bundle on M. Is every operator P in Psi^{-q,-infinity}(M, F, E) contained in the weak trace ideal L^{1+}(L^2(M, E)), with Dixmier trace Tr_omega(P) independent of the choice of invariant mean omega and equal to the residue trace tau(P)?

evidence.quote: A similar relation of the Dixmier trace Tr_omega with the transverse Riemannian volume form associated with a Riemannian foliation relies on the following conjecture...

Conjecture 5.9. Let (M, F) be a compact foliated manifold and E a vector bundle on M. Any P in Psi^{-q,-infinity}(M, F, E) (q = codim F) belongs to L^{1+}(L^2(M, E)), the Dixmier trace Tr_omega(P) does not depend on the choice of omega and coincides with the value of the residue trace tau(P).

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $(M, \mathcal{F})$ be a smooth compact foliated manifold of codimension $q$, and let $E \to M$ be a smooth complex vector bundle. Consider the bifiltered algebra of transverse pseudodifferential operators $\Psi^{m,k}(M,\mathcal{F},E)$ associated with the foliation (operators that are pseudodifferential of order $m$ in the transverse directions and of order $k$ in the leafwise directions), and in particular the class $\Psi^{-q,-\infty}(M,\mathcal{F},E)$ of operators of transverse order $-q$ and leafwise order $-\infty$. Equip $L^2(M,E)$ with a Hermitian structure and a smooth density on $M$, so that operators in $\Psi^{-q,-\infty}(M,\mathcal{F},E)$ extend to bounded operators on $L^2(M,E)$. Let $\mathcal{L}^{1+}(L^2(M,E))$ denote the Dixmier (weak trace) ideal of compact operators $T$ whose singular values $\mu_n(T)$ satisfy $\sum_{n\le N}\mu_n(T) = O(\log N)$, on which the Dixmier trace $\operatorname{Tr}_\omega$ is defined for each invariant mean $\omega$ on $\ell^\infty(\mathbb{N})$. Let $\tau : \Psi^{-q,-\infty}(M,\mathcal{F},E) \to \mathbb{C}$ denote the residue trace (the analogue of the Wodzicki residue) defined on this transverse calculus.

Prove or disprove: every $P \in \Psi^{-q,-\infty}(M,\mathcal{F},E)$ belongs to $\mathcal{L}^{1+}(L^2(M,E))$; the Dixmier trace $\operatorname{Tr}_\omega(P)$ is independent of the invariant mean $\omega$; and 
$$\operatorname{Tr}_\omega(P) = \tau(P).$$
artifact.status_search_result: The statement is posed as a conjecture in the noncommutative spectral geometry of Riemannian foliations. Web searches did not locate any published proof or counterexample establishing the full equality of the Dixmier trace with the residue trace on the transverse pseudodifferential class $\Psi^{-q,-\infty}(M,\mathcal{F},E)$ for general compact foliated manifolds. Related results (Connes' trace theorem, the Kordyukov–Sukochev–Zanin extensions, and noncommutative residues for Heisenberg/symplectic foliations) confirm analogous identities in special settings but do not resolve the foliated conjecture in full generality, so it appears to remain open.

status_evidence.title: Noncommutative Geometry, the spectral standpoint (Connes)
status_evidence.snippet: Surveys noncommutative geometry including Dixmier trace / residue trace relationships; the foliated transverse version is discussed as part of ongoing work.
status_evidence.claim: The Dixmier trace = Wodzicki residue identification is established in classical settings but the foliated analogue remains conjectural.

status_evidence.title: The Dixmier trace and the noncommutative residue for multipliers on compact manifolds
status_evidence.snippet: Refines Connes' trace theorem for classical pseudodifferential operators, subsuming the Kordyukov–Sukochev–Zanin extension.
status_evidence.claim: Recent advances on Dixmier-trace/residue identities focus on classical or multiplier settings rather than the transverse foliation calculus.
